"It Changed My Life Forever"

"My leaks used to constantly embarrass me, and I had tried everything to stop my leaks from showing through my pants...

Pads, liners, diapers... You name it, I tried it.

And while these helped a bit, they all felt bulky, uncomfortable and embarrassing!

Which is why I decided to try leakproof underwear and let me just tell you... Out of everything I've tried, it's by far the best idea out there!!

I'll put them on in the morning, go about my day as if I never had leaks, come home and then put a new pair on for bed.

Overall I'm really thankful for Everdries' leakproof underwear and all the confidence, comfort and happiness it's given me :)"

One of the toughest things about our new found bladder issues is they limit us from doing the things we once did.

Which is why we did everything possible to help you do the things you love, without having to make compromises.

We did this by making each pair with a 3-step absorption system:

Step 1: Liquid is absorbed into the leakproof liner

Step 2: The bottom of the liner traps the liquid so nothing can get through to your clothes

Step 3: The top of the liner wicks away any remaining moisture to keep you comfy and dry

Which may sound like a lot, but Everdries are super comfy and almost as thin as any other pair of underwear :)

Reusable Leakproof Underwear That Looks & Feels Just Like Regular Underwear!

Doesn't Let Any Leaks Through 

Even though Everdries look and feel just like regular underwear, they're far from it!

Our leakproof liner covers every area needed (& a bit more for extra protection!) to make sure not a single leak comes through.


Stays Comfy And Dry, Even After A Leak

The best part about Everdries is that you can wear them all day long, while staying comfy and dry.

And it's all thanks to our 3-step absorption system which sucks away and traps all liquid as far from your skin as possible.

The layer closest to your skin then quickly dries, keeping you feeling comfy and dry as if a leak never happened!

Reusable, Machine Washable & Hang Dry

Unlike pads, liners, diapers and every other "solution" available, Everdries is reusable for years to come. 

All you have to do is throw them in the machine with your regular laundry, and then let them hang dry.

Looks And Feels Like Regular Underwear

Everdries will easily hold up to 4 tsp of liquid, while keeping you dry and not an ounce of comfort or style is sacrificed.

You'll be able to enjoy the day with full confidence, knowing no leaks will come through and nobody will be able to tell you're wearing leakproof underwear - not even you (or your husband)!

Not to mention, they come in a bunch of cute colors!!

Frequently Asked Questions

Are they washable and reusable? Or do you throw them away after each use?

Everdries are both washable and reusable!


Meaning with proper care, you can wear them for months... Even years!


As for washing instructions, they're machine washable in cold water and should be hung to dry.

How much liquid can they hold?

Everdries are perfect for light to medium incontinence with them holding up to 4 tsp of liquid, with absolutely none of it going through!

Whenever a leak happens, the liquid is absorbed into the layer furthest away from your skin, while the gentle cotton liner quickly dries to keep you comfy and dry.

What fabric are they made of?

The outer layers of Everdries are made with 83% Nylon and 17% Spandex, while the liner and absorption layers are all 100% Cotton!

What are the washing instructions?

We recommend machine washing Everdries on cold, and letting them hang to dry.

Are they true to size? Or do they run small or large?

This style runs a little small, if in between sizes, we recommend sizing up for a better fit. We also have our 100% Perfect Fit Guarantee:

Try our underwear on at home, wash them and if you're not 100% satisfied with the fit within 30 days of receiving your order, simply send us an email telling us your order number and the size you need, and we'll send you the new size free of charge - no need to return the original product.

Is there a sizing chart?

There sure is!

What size should I order?

If you're still unsure or have any questions though, please email us at support@everdries.com and we'll be more than happy to help you out!

Where do you ship from? 

We ship from our warehouse in Phoenix, Arizona, with all orders arriving in 3 to 7 days!

Is they any odor? Will they stain?

The liner and absorption layers in Everdries are made with natural materials that are naturally anti-odor, meaning you'll never have to worry about odors!

As for stains, you won't have to worry about those either!

How much of the underwear is leakproof?

The leakproof layers in Everdries cover every area needed (& a bit more) for extra peace of mind! 

Whenever a leak happens, the liquid is absorbed into the layer furthest away from your skin, while the gentle cotton liner quickly dries to keep you comfy and dry.

As for how much liquid they can hold, Everdries will hold up to 4 tsp without any of it ever coming through or bothering you with a wet feeling!

Do they make any sounds when walking?

Nope! The outer layers of Everdries are made with 83% Nylon and 17% Spandex, while the liner and absorption layers are all 100% Cotton. None of which make any sounds when walking!

Can they be seen through your pants?

Nope! Everdries really do look and feel just like regular underwear. So unless your pants are very thin or are regularly see through, nobody will be able to see your Everdries.

What do they feel like when you're wearing them?

Everdries truly look and feel exactly like regular underwear while you're wearing them!

Even when a leak happens, the layers closest to you dry as quick as possible, while the further away absorption layers lock in all leaks without any wet feelings or odors.

Meaning Everdries always feel amazing!

Do they also work for periods?

While Everdries was originally created for incontinence, there's no reason you couldn't also wear Everdries on your period.

I want to order single pairs in a specific color. How can I do this?

We only sell Everdries in 5, 10, and 15 packs with mixed colors, being: Beige, Champagne, Pink, Nude, and Brown.
